semiconductor_relevance: High — Larcomse Equipment specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly in thermal processing technologies.
summary: Larcomse Equipment (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high-end semiconductor chip equipment, focusing on rapid thermal processing (RTP) technologies. The company serves various sectors within the semiconductor industry, including IDM and foundries, and has established a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and has R&D and manufacturing bases in Hefei, with technical service centers in multiple cities.
